name: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 + DFlash2 (SGLang, native window)

memory_estimate_mb.notes: Docker cap 100g (memory+swap) on a 128 GB unified pool; SGLang mem_fraction 0.50 with --disable-flashinfer-autotune (the measured GB10-safe ceiling for the native unit; docs/gb10-memory.md: above 0.50 with the autotuner on, SGLang's accounting misses 25-40 GB and can freeze the box). Measured on Hasso's reference box: KV pool 869,920-874,145 tokens at image v0.5.22. Boot 64 s (process start to 'fired up', lifecycle.py marker measurement).

ports.notes: Hasso box default PORT=30000, keepalive proxy PORT+1; per-box choice, not recipe material (kept as host placeholder upstream). Live 1c2c stock lane uses the same engine 8080 / proxy 8081 pair as flash — the two lanes are mutually exclusive.

64.notes: native window in a unit sized for a 64 GB Spark

multi_spark.rule: copy-on-tp-or-machine-change: this file is tp=1 on dgx-spark-gb10-128g. A tp=2 / tp2_pair or gx10-64g variant is a COPY with its own re-measured flags and memory_estimate_mb (never reinterpret this file at another shape); the fleet's live TP2 pair runs a different engine (vLLM aeon) and is a separate component anyway. A 1M-context copy is likewise a separate id (context mode changes mem_fraction and env).

notes: Upstream tok/s figures in alzeo README (65.2/68.5 greedy median, 2026-11-05) are citations, not local measurements or SLAs.
CONTEXT_MODE=1m is the alzeo default since v1.12.1. First 27B boot ~7-9 minutes.
switch-model.sh writes the unit and does not start the engine; start/stop are separate confirmed steps.
Prefer git checkout of pin 01902c67709c4164c30ccf036422bfed6f172158 then ./install.sh; never silent curl|sh.
install.sh --plan changes nothing; confirm runs MODEL_CHOICE=stock ./install.sh

switch.note: alzeo switch-model.sh <target> rewrites the 27B unit; then stop/start the units it prints
